title: F171.1 a photo or a PDF reaches a tool: the overview
caption: Four parts: the API takes a file as bytes, the session keeps it, a tool finds it by name, and the engine's reader has a model read it into the record the tool asks for, with the cost in the ledger.

cards.title: F171.1 A photo or a PDF reaches a tool
cards.code: engine work, no bill in sight
cards.text: A pack's tool can ask the engine to read an uploaded photo or PDF into a record of the pack's own.

cards.title: The API takes bytes
cards.text: An attachment carries its bytes and its type beside the text it carries today.

cards.title: The session keeps it
cards.text: Kept in memory with the session, capped, and named to the model, never pasted into the prompt.

cards.title: The reader reads it
cards.text: A file, instructions and a record type in, the filled record out, in one model call.

cards.title: The cost is counted
cards.text: Each reading is its own row in the usage ledger, and it replays in an eval.
